title: Brokerage services for ESO insurances
description: Division: DOA. Call for tender (CFT) covering the selection of a contractor for the provision of Brokerage services for ESO insurances. The CFT is scheduled to be issued in Q1/2023 to companies in the ESO Member States. The scope of the services includes: · ESO property insurance (all sites: Europe Headquarters (Garching near Munich, Germany), Chile Paranal/La Silla telescopes/facilities, ALMA telescopes/facilities, Santiago offices); · ESO Transport insurance; · ESO Public Liability insurance; · ESO private cars on duty trips insurance. The services will consist mainly in: 1) yearly brokerage support; 2) competitive renewal process by the broker, offer process, placement, policies issuing; 3) premiums and tax invoicing; 4) reporting and service level provision by the broker; 5) claims protocol and claims handling within defined timeframes; 6) organisation of risk management and site evaluations and related services and support. The contract is expected to be awarded in Q2/Q3/2023 to the bidder which has submitted a fully compliant tender and offers the best value for money for ESO taking into account the quality and price of the offer. title: 30 meters Truck-Mounted Aerial Platform
description:
In the framework of its activities at the Guiana Space Center (CSG), CNES must renew one 30 meters Truck-Mounted Aerial Platform. This truck allows to access equipment at height.

The truck, which is the subject of this pre-publication, must have the following equipment to perform its main functions:

30-meters working-height aerial platform mounted on a 4×2 truck chassis.
Diesel engine delivering at least 180 HP for reliable performance.
Articulating boom with multi-joint design for maximum reach and flexibility.
Platform capacity of 230 kg to safely carry two operators and tools.
Hydraulic outriggers with automatic leveling for fast, stable setup.
Joystick controls in both basket and base for precise movement.
Safety features including overload cutoff, fall arrest anchor points, and emergency descent.
Operator cab with air conditioning, ergonomic seat, and wide-angle viewing windows.
Tropical-grade cooling system, corrosion-resistant paint, and sealed electrical components.
Supplier to offer OEM parts support, local service network, stocked spares, and full warranty

title: Difuzare materiale video
description:
DottoTV HD este o televiziune generalistă, înființată în Constanța, un produs unicat pe piaţa audiovizualului din România. DottoTV HD emite 24 de ore din 24, acoperind un segment larg de programe. Postul poate fi recepţionat analogic, digital, cât şi prin satelit la toate companiile de cablu din județul Constanța și nu numai. Programele DottoTV HD se adresează unui public vast, atât din punct de vedere al vârstei, cât şi al intereselor telespectatorilor săi. De la emisiuni de divertisment pentru cei mici şi mari, la emisiuni informative, transmisiuni sportive, ştiri sau filme, canalul îşi adaptează grila în funcţie de aşteptările şi cerinţele publicului său, urmărind obţinerea unei audienţe cât mai extinse. Propunerea nostră de colaborare : 1) Știre în jurnal înaintea difuzării spectacolului – max. 2 minute 2) Editarea materialului și punerea graficii pe imagine 3) Difuzarea integrală a materialului e postul Dotto TV HD, dar și pe paginile media ale postului (Facebook și Youtube) sPECTACOL EXTRAORDINAR DE FOLCLOR DIN 08.08.2020
